newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Port conditions update - Pakistan - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Pakistan - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
PAKISTAN, March 26 - Karachi - Vessels waiting off port, one general cargo, waiting for three days, one container, waiting for three days, two loaders, first vessel waiting for seven days.
Three oil tankers, first vessel waiting for three days. Ten other vessels waiting off port for own reasons.
